publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for tenant-admin lifecycle and verification routes.

Shared type describing the tenant-admin subject used during tenant-auth onboarding.

dependsOn.description: Sends and handles tenant-admin verification emails through notification delivery public seams.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing tenant-admin verification or onboarding restart semantics can break the downstream tenant-auth onboarding flow.
